bugs.bug: asdf passes ASDF_INSTALL_TYPE, ASDF_INSTALL_VERSION and ASDF_INSTALL_PATH through to child processes without unsetting them on entry, so a recursive asdf call (a plugin script invoking asdf) inherits another install's values and uses the wrong version context
bugs.example: cli.go: Execute runs the app without clearing ASDF_INSTALL_TYPE/VERSION/PATH, so when a plugin callback calls asdf again those inherited variables override the values the nested command should compute
